title: PATH_PAYMENT_STRICT_SEND fails with PATH_PAYMENT_STRICT_SEND_LINE_FULL
pattern: A transaction whose PATH_PAYMENT_STRICT_SEND operation fails at apply is still written into the closed ledger: its fee is charged, its sequence number is consumed, and nothing it did is kept. The result carries the operation's code (line_full). An NRV strict-send payment into a trustline at its limit.

facts.says: No operation changed state: the operation meta is empty.
The fee is still charged: the fee source changes in fee processing.
